title: Greek inventor's steam sphere

tellings.quote: There was there was a a Greek inventor that uh made a a circle a

plain: An inventor in ancient Greece is said to have built a sphere driven by steam. Greg Rogers, who is introduced as a NASA doctor and who says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar, mentions it in passing without naming the inventor or a source. He brings it up as an example of advanced technology appearing far earlier than people expect.
